title: USCG Air Station Clearwater Cylinder Rental Services
description:
This combined synopsis/solicitation for services is prepared in accordance with the format in subpart 12.6 of the Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) as supplemented with additional information included in this notice. This synopsis/solicitation is being advertised as Small Business Set-Aside only. This announcement constitutes the only solicitation; no separate written solicitation will be issued. The solicitation number is 70ZL26-27-ASCW-CylinderRentalServices. This requirement is for a firm fixed price services contract. The contract will be awarded using simplified acquisition procedures in accordance with FAR part 13. 

  

   Solicitation Information:   

 Solicitation Number: 70ZL26-27-ASCW-CylinderRentalServices 

 Set-Aside: 100% Small Business Set-Aside 

 Applicable NAICS Code: 561210 - Facilities Support Services 

 Size Standard: $47.0 Million 

 Wage determinations: 2015-4571, Rev 31 dated 08/27/2026 

 Contract Type: Firm-Fixed-Price (FFP) Services 

 Authority: FAR Part 12 (Commercial Products/Services) and FAR Part 13 (Simplified Acquisition Procedures) 

  

   Period of Performance:   

 ARO – 31 December 2027 (13 Months) 

   Performance Location   :  USCG Coast Guard Air Station Clearwater, 15100 Rescue Way, Clearwater, FL 33762 

   Scope of Work:   

 The U.S. Coast Guard Air Station Clearwater requires recurring Cylinder Rental services in accordance with the attached Statement of Work (SOW). 

   Site Visit Details   

   Site Visit Policy:   It is highly recommended and encouraged that a site visit is performed at the Unit to verify the requirements within the SOW and speak with the unit POC for this service. No other site visit dates will be provided without approval from point of contact. 

  Date & Time:  Coordinate with POC 

  Point of Contact (POC):  

 SK1 Audra Pachmayer: Audra.M.Pachmayer@uscg.mil PH: (206) 820-5164 

 CWO Raul Jimenez:  Raul.A.Jimenez@uscg.mil  PH: (571) 607-9250 

   Question and Answers:   

 Submission: All questions must be submitted to   Arlett.Maj@uscg.mil   by no later than   November 27, 2026, at 9:00 AM (0900) EST  . 

 Amendments: Q&As will be compiled, answered, and posted to this solicitation as an official solicitation amendment prior to   November 29th, 2026  . 

   Proposal Submission Instructions   

 To be considered for award, quotes must be submitted via email to: Arlett.Maj@uscg.mil 

 Required Email Subject Line: 70ZL26-27-ASCW-CylinderRentalServices 

 Offerors must have an "ACTIVE" registration status in the System for Award Management (SAM) prior to the close of this solicitation (https://www.sam.gov). 

 Provide Vendor Unique Entity Identifier (UEI) and Cage Number 

 Telephone requests of quotes will not be accepted, a formal notice of changes (if applicable) will be issued in SAM.GOV. 

 Period of Performance: Performance of work is expected to commence:  ARO December 2026  

  No extensions to the submission deadline will be provided.   

   When submitting your proposal, request a price breakdown of the following:   

 
	 Pricing for each CLIN/period: (Monthly Price) 
	 Technical approach or capability statement 
	 Past performance references: 3 recent relevant contracts with organization names, contract numbers, and point of contact (if applicable) 
 

  

  Pricing:  

 December 2026 – 31 December 2027 

   Evaluation   

 1. Technical Acceptability: Meeting or exceeding all requirements in the SOW 

 2. Price: 13 Months 

 3. Past performance (if applicable) 

   Anticipated award date:   02 business days after close of solicitation. 

 Quotes are to be received no later than close  10:00 AM EST ( 1000) 03 December 2026.   

  

   Invoicing & Billing   

 Invoicing must be submitted monthly in arrears via the Invoice Processing Platform (IPP) (https://www.ipp.gov). 

 The contractor shall not exceed the monthly fixed-price invoicing amount without prior written authorization from the Contracting Officer. 

   Applicable FAR Clauses by References:    

 52.212-4- 52.212.5 Contract Terms and Conditions Commercial Items 

 52.217-8 Option to Extend Services (NOV 1999) 

 52.217-9- Option to Extend Term of Contract (MAR 2000) 

 52.232-18-Availability of Funds (APR 1984) 

 52.222-90- Addressing DEI Discrimination by Federal Contractors 

 The following Homeland Security Acquisition Regulations (HSAR) are incorporated as addenda to this solicitation: HSAR 3052.209-70 Prohibition on Contracts with Corporate Expatriates (Jun 2006); Contracting Officers Technical Representative (Dec 2003) (COTR) HSAR 3052.237-72. Copies of HSAR clauses may be obtained electronically at http://www.dhs.gov.
